subject: Math
prompt: The width of a rectangular community garden plot is $p$ meters. The length of the plot is $9$ meters longer than its width. Which of the following expresses the perimeter, in meters, of the garden plot in terms of $p$?
explanation: Choice B is correct. The width of the garden plot is $p$ meters. The length is $9$ meters longer than the width, so the length is $p + 9$ meters. The perimeter is the sum of all four sides: $p + p + (p + 9) + (p + 9) = 4p + 18$.
